clue.text: Island politician with easy win — trade union unprepared

parts.note: I is the standard abbreviation for island on maps
MP, Member of Parliament
a romp is a victory won with ease

explanation.surface: An island MP cruises to victory while the trade union is caught off guard.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done off the cuff, without rehearsal, is done with no preparation.

clue.text: Data from virgin forest

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the words that follow, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: Information gathered from untouched woodland.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal short form for information, which is a near synonym of data.

clue.text: Post Office in funds — that's the intention

indicators.note: in tells us the Post Office letters sit inside the word for funds

parts.note: a purse is a sum of money, funds available

explanation.surface: Someone explains that money is going into the Post Office on purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: an aim or goal one means to achieve.

clue.text: Mineral course oddly abandoned

indicators.note: the letters in odd positions of course are dropped, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: A geology course has been strangely dropped from the syllabus.
explanation.definitionFit: Rock from which a metal or mineral is extracted, loosely a mineral itself.

clue.text: Vegetable, too apt, switched

indicators.note: switched around means the letters of the two little words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vegetable that is all too appropriate has been swapped for another.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a starchy tuber eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Eerie, lunar, they recollected

indicators.note: re-collected, gathered up again in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Astronauts remembered the moon as a spooky place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' reads as remembered, but splits as re-collected, gathered up again in a new order.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: weird and ghostly, as if not of this world.

clue.text: Girl quiet in the morning

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
AM, ante meridiem, the hours before noon

explanation.surface: A girl keeps quiet in the early hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a female first name, short for Pamela.

clue.text: Type of ham of standard expected by mother

parts.note: par is the normal or expected level, as in golf
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Mother expects ham of a decent standard.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an Italian cured ham named after the city where it is made.

clue.text: Tool satisfied everyone inside

indicators.note: inside puts the word for everyone within the word for satisfied

parts.note: met as in met the demand, satisfied it
all means every person

explanation.surface: A tool has pleased everybody in the workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hammer with a large wooden head.

clue.text: Pro, qualified, bagging English penalty

parts.note: for means in favour of, as pro does

indicators.note: bagging means putting into a bag, so the letter for English goes inside

parts.note: fit as in fit for the job, qualified

explanation.surface: A qualified professional pockets an English penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: something lost or paid as a punishment for a wrong.

clue.text: In from France given theatrical part, we hear, register for course

parts.note: en is French for in

indicators.note: we hear says the word for a part in a play is given by how it sounds

parts.note: a role is an actor's part

explanation.surface: A French arrival lands a stage part and signs up for a course.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to sign up formally as a student or member.

clue.text: Came, met group playing — this?

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of the first three words are moved around

explanation.surface: Friends came round, met as a group and played something; what was it?
explanation.definitionFit: Example: what a group meeting up to play on a console would be playing.

clue.text: Dull pool of water upset 3, American

parts.note: a pond is a small body of still water

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word read upwards

parts.note: refers to 3 down, whose answer is a mineral
US for United States, American

explanation.surface: A dull American pond has been disturbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: heavy, laboured and tedious in style.

clue.text: Tubular vessel some have internally

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people carry a tube-like vessel inside their bodies.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomy: a blood vessel, a tube carrying blood back to the heart.

clue.text: Finally crash via fall of fifty per cent

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of each of the next four words

explanation.surface: A crash comes from a market fall of fifty per cent.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: one of two equal parts, a share of a hundred split down the middle.

clue.text: This might advertise small bit of greenery

definitions.meaning: a printed handout used to promote something
a little leaf, or one division of a compound leaf

explanation.surface: A sprig of greenery might be used to promote something.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a printed flyer, and literally a small leaf.

clue.text: Clumsy to get nothing for ultimately game S American cowboy

indicators.note: for says the letter for nothing stands in place of another

parts.note: gauche means awkward, clumsy

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of game

parts.note: O, the round shape of zero

explanation.surface: An awkward player gets nowhere in the end in a South American game.
explanation.walkthrough: In GAUCHE the E (last of 'game') is replaced by O.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a horseman herding cattle on the pampas.

clue.text: Group following religious instruction award

indicators.note: following places the group word after the abbreviation for religious instruction

parts.note: RI, the school subject of religious instruction
a band is a group, of musicians or people

explanation.surface: A group of pupils wins a prize after a scripture lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a ribbon worn as a mark of honour, such as the Blue Riband.

clue.text: Study period — irrelevant, you experienced at redbrick first of all

parts.note: academic as in a purely academic point, of no practical relevance
Y is a short form of you, as in text speak

indicators.note: first of all takes the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: A student finds a redbrick university term irrelevant despite experience.
explanation.walkthrough: A redbrick is one of the British universities founded in industrial cities around 1900.
explanation.definitionFit: The yearly cycle of teaching at a school or university, a period of study.

clue.text: Article lying flat, almost, in airport area

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: prone means lying face down

explanation.surface: An item lies nearly flat somewhere at the airport.
explanation.definitionFit: Aviation term: the paved zone where aircraft park, load and refuel.

clue.text: One changing colour extremely dirty I hesitate to say

indicators.note: extremely picks out the two extreme letters, first and last, of dirty

parts.note: er is the sound of a hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates to admit that a colour has become filthy.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who tints fabric or hair, giving it a new shade.

clue.text: Unusual item copper linked with port in Brazil

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian port city

explanation.surface: An odd copper piece turns up in a Brazilian harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A rare or strange object collected as a curiosity.

clue.text: Feeling Hamlet, say, gives radio exposure

parts.note: air as in an air of mystery, a feeling or atmosphere
Hamlet is an example of a play, by Shakespeare

explanation.surface: The mood of a Hamlet production gets it on the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: The broadcasting of a record or programme on radio, giving it exposure.

clue.text: Move in water dispute

definitions.meaning: to propel a boat with oars
a noisy quarrel, rhyming with cow

explanation.surface: An argument over moving on the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to propel a boat with oars, and a quarrel.

clue.text: Private heading away from urban area

indicators.note: the heading, the first letter, goes away from the word for an urban area

parts.note: a town is an urban area

explanation.surface: A soldier marches off out of town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Private' looks like a soldier but is an adjective, as in one's own room.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective: belonging to oneself alone, personal.

clue.text: Manoeuvring seaward — to drink

indicators.note: manoeuvring moves things about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ship manoeuvres out to sea to fetch a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: carbonated water drunk alone or as a mixer.
